integrity: The proof is self-contained and exhausts every even factorization type with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). The two-support cases reduce to three elementary equations, while the squarefree three-support case reduces exactly to \((p-7)(q-7)=48\). The packaged computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only even solutions of \(\sigma(n)=4\varphi(n)\) with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not settle the full even three-distinct-prime-support branch; published examples with larger total multiplicity occur immediately beyond the boundary. An equivalent low-total-multiplicity observation in unindexed notes remains a residual originality risk.
title: The first total-multiplicity layer of the exceptional quotient-four totient problem
